title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add Item Attributes Factbox (9110, ListPart) to Item Ledger Entries page
summary: Item attributes allow businesses to assign and search items by characteristics like height and model year. This post shows how to extend the Item Ledger Entries page with the Item Attributes Factbox using a page extension and the LoadItemAttributesData method triggered on record changes.
key_points: Item attributes enable storing and filtering items by customer-relevant characteristics
The Item Attributes Factbox is a standard list part (9110) included on Item Card and Item List pages
To add the factbox to other pages, use a page extension with the OnAfterGetCurrRecord trigger to call LoadItemAttributesData
The factbox calculation happens dynamically in the trigger rather than through SubPageLink property

quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the key code pattern needed to dynamically load item attributes data in the OnAfterGetCurrRecord trigger
